meta.credit: Transferred from en.wikipedia to Commons by Podzemnik using CommonsHelper.
meta.desc: The main Stupa crowning the Borobudur Buddhist monument in Java, Indonesia. The largest Buddhist monument in the world, it was built in the 8th century by the Sailendra dynasty. The upper rounded terrace with rows of bell shaped stupas containing Buddha images symbolize Arupadhatu, the sphere of formlesness. The main stupa itself is empty, symbolizing complete perfection of enlightenment.

meta.title: File:Wisatawan Borobudur.jpg
meta.desc: Borobudur is a Buddhist temple located in Borobudur, Magelang, Central Java, Indonesia. The temple was built during the heyday of the Syailendra dynasty around 824 AD and was completed around the 900s AD, during the reign of Queen Pramudawardhani who was the daughter of Samaratungga. While the architect who helped to build this temple according to the story of generations named Gunadharma.

meta.desc: Dalam bahasa Inggris sebagai The Unfinished Buddha dan oleh warga lokal disebut Mbah Belet. Arca batu ikonik dan penuh misteri yang diyakini secara luas berasal dari dalam stupa induk (stupa terbesar di puncak tertinggi) Candi Borobudur.
